title: Grade 8 French — Wed, May 20
description: Passé composé (avoir) — Day 3 of 5: Irregular past participles
subject: french

questions.question: Past participle of AVOIR (to have):
questions.explanation: AVOIR → EU (irregular). J'ai eu = I had/I have had. EU is completely irregular.

questions.question: Past participle of FAIRE (to do/make):
questions.explanation: FAIRE → FAIT (irregular). J'ai fait = I did/I have done/I made.

questions.question: Past participle of PRENDRE (to take):
questions.explanation: PRENDRE → PRIS (irregular). J'ai pris = I took. Same for comprendre (compris), apprendre (appris).

questions.question: Past participle of VOIR (to see):
questions.explanation: VOIR → VU. J'ai vu = I saw. 'J'ai vu un beau film hier.' = I saw a great film yesterday.

questions.question: Past participle of BOIRE (to drink):
questions.explanation: BOIRE → BU. J'ai bu = I drank. 'Tu as bu de l'eau?' = Did you drink water?

questions.question: Past participle of LIRE (to read):
questions.explanation: LIRE → LU. J'ai lu = I read. 'Elle a lu le livre entier.' = She read the whole book.

questions.question: Past participle of METTRE (to put/place):
questions.explanation: METTRE → MIS. J'ai mis = I put. Also: admettre (admis), promettre (promis), permettre (permis).

questions.question: Past participle of POUVOIR (to be able to/can):
questions.explanation: POUVOIR → PU. J'ai pu = I was able to/I could. 'Je n'ai pas pu venir.' = I couldn't come.

questions.question: Past participle of SAVOIR (to know):
questions.explanation: SAVOIR → SU. J'ai su = I found out / I knew. (Often 'I found out' rather than general 'I knew' which uses imparfait.)

questions.question: Translate: 'I did my homework.' (faire → fait)
questions.explanation: 'J'ai fait mes devoirs.' = I did my homework. FAIRE → FAIT (irregular past participle).

questions.question: Translate: 'They saw the Eiffel Tower.' (voir → vu)
options: Ils ont vu la Tour Eiffel.
Ils ont vue la Tour Eiffel.
Ils ont vu la Tour Eiffel.
questions.explanation: 'Ils ont vu la Tour Eiffel.' = They saw the Eiffel Tower. VOIR → VU. (The past participle doesn't change with avoir.)

questions.question: Match: avoir → ___, faire → ___, prendre → ___, voir → ___, boire → ___
questions.explanation: The Big 5 irregulars: AVOIR→EU, FAIRE→FAIT, PRENDRE→PRIS, VOIR→VU, BOIRE→BU. Memorize these.

questions.question: Why do we need to learn irregular past participles separately?
options: They follow random patterns with no logic
They don't follow the -é/-i/-u rules — each must be memorized individually
They are the same as English irregular verbs
questions.explanation: Irregular past participles don't follow -ER/-IR/-RE patterns. Must memorize: eu, fait, pris, vu, bu, lu, mis, pu, su, dit, écrit, ouvert... These are the most common verbs!

questions.question: Past participle of DIRE (to say):
questions.explanation: DIRE → DIT. J'ai dit = I said. 'Elle a dit bonjour.' = She said hello.

questions.question: Build a past sentence: 'Last year, they (ils) read many books and saw many films.'
options: L'année dernière, ils ont lu beaucoup de livres et ont vu beaucoup de films.
L'année dernière, ils lisaient beaucoup de livres et voyaient beaucoup de films.
L'année dernière, ils ont lire beaucoup de livres et vu beaucoup de films.
L'année dernière, ils ont lu beaucoup de livres et ont vus beaucoup de films.
questions.explanation: LIRE→LU, VOIR→VU (no agreement with avoir). 'Ils ont lu... et ont vu...' = They read... and saw...
